notes:
Summary: NeonStack Labs is building a latency-sensitive IDE copilot (VSCode + web IDE) focused on token-efficient completions and deterministic behavior across regions. Primary asks: consistent TTFT (time-to-first-token) below ~80ms for single-line completions at 95th, smooth streaming with controlled jitter to avoid editor cursor jitter/flashes, backpressure/flow-control hooks for the extension, and token budget controls to limit per-session spend. They prefer model/version pinning and deterministic fallbacks to smaller quantized variants during bursty loads.

Key quote: "We measure UX by first character appearing — if that blinks, engineers lose trust. Need predictable first-token latency." — CTO (L. Harper).

Technical requirements: single-line completions (primary), multi-line snippet expansion (secondary), re-ranker for inline suggestions. TTFT targets: median 25-40ms, 95th < 80ms, 99th < 150ms (stretch). Inter-token jitter target: variance <20ms for streamed partials. Backpressure: SDK must expose pause/resume and token-budget feedback so extension can trim context or fall back to cached suggestions. Token budget tuning: session-level budget (e.g., 300 tokens/day per user), soft/hard limits, realtime billing estimate, early-stop callbacks. Model/version pinning: ability to pin to specific quantized variant; graceful fallback to smaller models when latency thresholds breached. Observability needs: per-request TTFT, per-token timing histogram, route-level cost breakdown, prefix-cache hit rate.

POC plan: Week 0: send streaming SDK preview + VSCode sample. Week 1: synthetic bench for TTFT under simulated editor traffic (bursty small completions + long snippet expansions). Week 2: integrate with staging VSCode (10 internal devs), tune batching, chunk size, server-side KV caching. Post-POC: review costs and recommend Optimize settings (batch windows, quantization profiles).

Open items: legal wants explicit EU data residency SLA; risk of GPU cold-start spikes on 95th percentile; tokenizer mismatch risk (custom subword rules).

Action items: SE Diego to deliver streaming SDK + sample by 2026-03-07. Create POC telemetry dashboard in Console with TTFT and token budget metrics. Legal to receive security FAQ and DP terms.
